meta_description:
3,835 likes, 54 comments - abhinavmahajanlife on September 3, 2026: "Sports expose you. They expose your strengths and weaknesses. Your confidence and your insecurities.
Your courage and your fears. They show you how you react when things don’t go your way, how you handle pressure when everyone is watching and who you become when you’re pushed to your limits. You can hide many things in life. But on the field, eventually, you meet yourself. And maybe that’s why we keep coming back.".
